text:
marta: Heads-up: rapier21b-int6 canary showing intermittent OOM during load test. Only triggers when we combine large ctx + concurrent batchers.

chen: which nodes? pattern?

marta: repro on canary-a and canary-b. Failure rate ~6% when batch_window=40ms and prefetch_window=256.

marta: paste from memdump: 
```
[2026-04-04T02:02:12Z] ERROR OOM 83MiB alloc failed
node=canary-a
model=rapier21b-mixed-int6
phase=kv_concat
prefetch_windows=[256,256]
active_gen=5
batch_inflight=3
heap_frag_ratio=0.71
alloc_trace: small-alloc x1200 (4k-16k)
```

david: interesting - small alloc storm + high frag_ratio. sounds like allocator churn from prefetch creating lots of tiny buffers.

kai: can we try aggressive coalescing or increase freelist thresholds? we rolled freelist tune on prod earlier but canary still old.

marta: quick experiment: disabled prefetch (prefetch_window=0) and set batch_window=15ms -> no OOMs in 2h of stress. latency tail increased a bit but within service SLO for this canary.

chen: can we run a quality check with prefetch=0? worried about generation quality on long prompts.

marta: ran micro-evals (100 prompts): ppl change +1.1% vs baseline fp16, pass on QA. link to notebook: https://redwood.internal/run/rapier-int6-prefetch-evs

ops-bot: deploy plan: rolling patch to enable slab_coalesce on canary-a,b,c scheduled in 10m.

kai: if coalesce helps we can keep prefetch but reduce prefetch_window to 128 as a compromise. also add reserve_slots=0.2 for pool.

david: other mitigation: add request-level retry that falls back to no-prefetch path if allocation fails. cheap to implement and avoids 500s.

marta: added repro script and results gist: /eng-ml/bringups/rapier21b/repro.md. Also noted that int6 kernels sometimes allocate temp int32 staging buffer during KV concat; switching that kernel to an in-place path removes ~20MiB peak.

chen: nice find. can you open a tiny PR to add an in-place path + fallback? tag me for review.

marta: will do. action summary: (1) ops -> roll slab_coalesce to canaries; (2) eng -> add fallback retry + in-place kv path; (3) ml -> run full 500-sample eval with prefetch=0 and prefetch=128 after coalesce.

kai: started slab_coalesce rollout. monitoring memfrag and allocation_spikes.

ops-bot: rollout update: canary-a complete, canary-b in progress.

marta: canary-a running 6h with prefetch=128, batch_window=30ms: zero OOMs, allocation_spike_count reduced from ~87 -> ~4 per hour. tail latency +5ms p95.

david: good signal. once PRs land we'll re-run the full eval and if delta <2% promote change to staging.

chen: thanks all. leaving thread open for PR links and final eval numbers. :rocket:
